name: VR Breakdown level
summary: This EA implements a simple breakout strategy that trades when price breaks above the previous bar's high (BUY) or below the previous bar's low (SELL). It monitors open positions on each tick and sets Stop Loss and Take Profit levels if they are missing or need updating. The strategy resets breakout levels after a trade is triggered, waiting for the next new bar to establish fresh levels.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了一个简单的突破策略，当价格突破前一根K线的最高价时买入，跌破前一根K线的最低价时卖出。每个tick检查持仓并设置止损止盈，交易触发后重置突破水平，等待下一个新K线建立新的水平。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于价格突破前一根K线的最高价和最低价进行交易，属于经典的突破策略。入场条件为：当Ask价格大于等于前一根K线最高价时开多单，当Bid价格小于等于前一根K线最低价时开空单。出场条件依赖固定的止损和止盈点数（止损200点，止盈400点），止盈是止损的两倍，风险收益比为1:2。仓位管理仅使用固定手数（0.01手），在初始化时根据品种的最小手数步长进行校正，但若校正后手数低于最小允许值则设为0，可能导致EA无法交易。资金管理方面没有动态仓位调整或资金比例计算，完全依赖用户手动设定手数。策略在每次交易成功后会重置突破水平，避免同一水平重复入场，直到新K线形成才更新水平。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on trading breakouts of the previous bar's high and low, which is a classic breakout approach. Entry conditions: a BUY is triggered when the Ask price reaches or exceeds the previous bar's high, and a SELL is triggered when the Bid price reaches or falls below the previous bar's low. Exit conditions rely on fixed Stop Loss and Take Profit values in points (SL=200 points, TP=400 points), giving a risk-reward ratio of 1:2. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size (0.01 lots), corrected during initialization to conform to the symbol's volume step, but if the corrected lot falls below the minimum allowed volume it is set to 0, which could prevent the EA from trading entirely. Money management lacks dynamic position sizing or percentage-of-equity calculation, relying entirely on a user-specified static lot value. The strategy resets breakout levels after a successful trade, preventing repeated entries at the same level until a new bar forms and establishes fresh reference levels.

parameters.name: iMagicNumber
parameters.description: EA订单唯一标识符（魔幻号）

pros: 策略逻辑简洁清晰，代码易于理解和维护
止损止盈比例1:2，具有正期望的风险收益比
每次交易后重置突破水平，避免在同一水平反复开仓
使用魔幻号过滤持仓，不会干扰其他EA或手动交易
包含止损止盈的合规性检查（CheckSL_TP），尊重经纪商的最小止损距离要求
pros_en: Simple and clean strategy logic, code is easy to understand and maintain
Stop Loss to Take Profit ratio of 1:2 provides a positive risk-reward expectation
Breakout levels reset after each trade, avoiding repeated entries at the same level
Uses magic number to filter positions, preventing interference with other EAs or manual trades
Includes broker compliance check (CheckSL_TP) respecting minimum stop level requirements
cons: 没有检查是否已有同方向持仓，可能在同一突破方向上反复开仓导致过度暴露
固定手数无动态仓位管理，无法根据账户资金或波动率调整风险
突破策略在震荡行情中会产生大量假突破导致连续亏损
没有交易次数限制或最大持仓限制，风险敞口不可控
如果手数校正后低于最小手数则设为0，EA将静默无法交易且无警告提示
cons_en: No check for existing positions in the same direction, potentially opening multiple positions on the same breakout and overexposing the account
Fixed lot size with no dynamic position sizing, unable to adjust risk based on account equity or volatility
Breakout strategy generates many false signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses
No trade count limit or maximum position limit, risk exposure is uncontrolled
If corrected lot size falls below minimum volume it is silently set to 0 with no warning, making the EA unable to trade without user awareness
improvements: 增加持仓数量限制和同方向持仓检查，避免过度开仓
添加动态仓位管理（如基于账户余额百分比或ATR波动率），替代固定手数
增加震荡行情过滤器（如ADX或ATR阈值），在低波动率或横盘时暂停交易
当手数校正后低于最小值时，应在OnInit中返回INIT_FAILED并输出错误日志
添加最大回撤保护或每日最大亏损限制，防止极端行情下的巨额亏损
improvements_en: Add position count limits and same-direction position checks to prevent overexposure
Implement dynamic position sizing (e.g., percentage of account equity or ATR-based) instead of fixed lots
Add a range/choppy market filter (e.g., ADX or ATR threshold) to pause trading during low-volatility or sideways conditions
When corrected lot size falls below minimum, OnInit should return INIT_FAILED and log an error message
Add maximum drawdown protection or daily loss limits to prevent catastrophic losses in extreme market conditions

risk_points: 无持仓数量限制，可能在同一方向重复开仓导致过度暴露
突破策略在震荡市中会产生大量假信号和连续亏损
无最大回撤或每日亏损保护机制
手数校正失败时静默设为0，用户可能不知EA无法交易
risk_points_en: No position count limit, potentially opening multiple positions in the same direction leading to overexposure
Breakout strategy generates many false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets
No maximum drawdown or daily loss protection mechanism
Lot correction failure silently sets lots to 0, user may be unaware the EA cannot trade
